name: Spain (state law)
note: Spanish state law: Código Civil as amended by Ley 8/2021 (support measures and preventive powers), Ley 41/2002 (patient autonomy) and Ley 30/1979 (organ donation). Catalonia, Aragón, Navarre, the Basque Country, Galicia and the Balearics have their own civil law of succession, which is not covered here.

citations.title: Extinción del mandato
citations.quote: El mandato se acaba: 1.º Por su revocación ... 3.º Por muerte o por concurso del mandante o del mandatario.

citations.title: Medidas de apoyo
citations.quote: Las medidas de apoyo ... son, además de las de naturaleza voluntaria, la guarda de hecho, la curatela y el defensor judicial.

citations.title: Medidas voluntarias de apoyo
citations.quote: podrá prever o acordar en escritura pública medidas de apoyo relativas a su persona o bienes

citations.title: Poder preventivo con cláusula de subsistencia
citations.quote: El poderdante podrá incluir una cláusula que estipule que el poder subsista si en el futuro precisa apoyo en el ejercicio de su capacidad.

citations.title: Poder que solo surte efecto si se precisa apoyo
citations.quote: El poderdante podrá otorgar poder solo para el supuesto de que en el futuro precise apoyo en el ejercicio de su capacidad.

citations.title: Vigencia y extinción de los poderes preventivos
citations.quote: el cese de la convivencia producirá su extinción automática

citations.title: Constitución judicial de la curatela
citations.quote: La autoridad judicial constituirá la curatela mediante resolución motivada cuando no exista otra medida de apoyo suficiente

citations.title: Apertura de la sucesión
citations.quote: Los derechos a la sucesión de una persona se transmiten desde el momento de su muerte.

citations.title: Sucesión de los herederos
citations.quote: Los herederos suceden al difunto por el hecho solo de su muerte en todos sus derechos y obligaciones.

citations.title: Nombramiento de albaceas
citations.quote: El testador podrá nombrar uno o más albaceas.

citations.title: Extracción de órganos de fallecidos
citations.quote: podrá realizarse con fines terapéuticos o científicos, en el caso de que éstos no hubieran dejado constancia expresa de su oposición

citations.title: Instrucciones previas
citations.quote: manifiesta anticipadamente su voluntad ... sobre los cuidados y el tratamiento de su salud o, una vez llegado el fallecimiento, sobre el destino de su cuerpo

citations.title: Revocación de las instrucciones previas
citations.quote: Las instrucciones previas podrán revocarse libremente en cualquier momento dejando constancia por escrito.

roles.name: Apoderado con poder preventivo
roles.summary: A notarial power whose grantor has added a clause keeping it alive if they later need support. Without that clause a Spanish mandate ends when support measures are established.

assigned.event: Granted in escritura pública before a notary

starts.event: On grant; it continues into incapacity because of the subsistence clause

ends.event: Revocation, or death of the grantor
Automatically where granted to a spouse or partner and cohabitation ceases

transitions.event: Grantor needs support; power subsists and other support measures do not displace it

nameEn.en: Agent holding a preventive power of attorney

roles.name: Apoderado con poder que solo surte efecto si se precisa apoyo
roles.summary: A power granted to take effect only if the grantor later needs support. How that situation is proved is whatever the grantor specified, backed if necessary by a notarial act with expert evidence.

assigned.event: Granted before a notary for the future case of needing support

starts.event: When the need for support arises, proved as the grantor provided

ends.event: Revocation or death of the grantor

transitions.event: Acreditada la situación de necesidad de apoyo

nameEn.en: Agent under a power that takes effect only if support is needed

roles.name: Mandatario (mandato ordinario)
roles.summary: An ordinary mandate. It ends on the grantor's death and also when representative curatela is established for them.

ends.event: Revocation, death or insolvency of either party, or establishment of representative curatela

transitions.event: Muerte del mandante o curatela representativa (art. 1732)

citation.cite: Spanish Civil Code 2016 (Ministerio de Justicia English translation, consolidated text to 6 October 2015), arts 1709-1710
citation.title: On mandates (unofficial translation published by the Ministry of Justice; law as of 6 Oct 2015)
citation.quote: Pursuant to the mandate contract one person undertakes to provide a service ... as deduced from the acts of the mandatary.

roles.name: Curador
roles.summary: A court establishes curatela only where no other support measure suffices, and specifies the acts for which assistance is required. Representative curatela is exceptional.

assigned.event: Judicial authority constitutes curatela by reasoned decision

conditions: no existe otra medida de apoyo suficiente

roles.name: Guardador de hecho
roles.summary: An informal support measure recognised by the Code alongside curatela and the judicial defender, requiring no appointment.

starts.event: When the person in fact provides support

ends.event: Death, or a sufficient formal support measure replaces it

transitions.event: Guarda de hecho como medida de apoyo (art. 250)
Constitución de curatela u otra medida suficiente

roles.name: Representante designado en instrucciones previas
roles.summary: Through an advance instructions document a person states their treatment wishes and may name a representative; it also covers what happens to the body and organs after death.

assigned.event: Named in the instrucciones previas document

starts.event: When the grantor can no longer express their wishes personally

ends.event: Authority over the body and organs continues past death by the document’s own terms; the document itself may be revoked freely in writing at any time while the grantor can do so

transitions.event: Otorgamiento del documento de instrucciones previas
El otorgante no puede expresar personalmente su voluntad
Revocación libre en cualquier momento, dejando constancia por escrito (art. 11.4)

roles.name: Heredero
roles.summary: Rights to the succession transmit from the moment of death and the heirs succeed to all the deceased's rights and obligations by the mere fact of that death.

citation.cite: Spanish Civil Code 2016 (Ministerio de Justicia English translation, consolidated text to 6 October 2015), art 660
citation.title: Heir and legatee (unofficial translation published by the Ministry of Justice; law as of 6 Oct 2015)
citation.quote: A person who succeeds pursuant to universal title shall be called heir

citation.cite: Spanish Civil Code 2016 (Ministerio de Justicia English translation, consolidated text to 6 October 2015), art 660
citation.title: Heir and legatee (unofficial translation published by the Ministry of Justice; law as of 6 Oct 2015)
citation.quote: A person who succeeds pursuant to universal title shall be called heir

citation.cite: Spanish Civil Code 2016 (Ministerio de Justicia English translation, consolidated text to 6 October 2015), art 981
citation.title: Accretion among co-heirs (unofficial translation published by the Ministry of Justice; law as of 6 Oct 2015)
citation.quote: the share of the heir who refuses the inheritance shall always accrue in favour of his co-heirs.

roles.name: Albacea
roles.summary: An executor exists only if the testator named one; the heirs otherwise hold the estate directly.

starts.event: On death and acceptance of the office

transitions.event: Aceptación del cargo tras el fallecimiento

citation.cite: Spanish Civil Code 2016 (Ministerio de Justicia English translation, consolidated text to 6 October 2015), art 892
citation.title: On executors or administrators (unofficial translation published by the Ministry of Justice; law as of 6 Oct 2015)
citation.quote: The testator may appoint one or more executors.

citation.cite: Spanish Civil Code 2016 (Ministerio de Justicia English translation, consolidated text to 6 October 2015), art 892
citation.title: On executors or administrators (unofficial translation published by the Ministry of Justice; law as of 6 Oct 2015)
citation.quote: The testator may appoint one or more executors.

roles.name: Persona cuya oposición consta (donación de órganos)
roles.summary: Spain presumes donation: organs may be removed from the deceased unless they had expressly recorded their opposition.

assigned.event: By law; no appointment. The deceased's own recorded opposition governs

ends.event: Removal carried out or barred by recorded opposition

transitions.event: Fallecimiento sin constancia expresa de oposición (art. quinto)

nameEn.en: Person whose objection is on record (organ donation)

roles.name: Persona que decide el destino del cuerpo
roles.summary: The advance instructions document may state what is to happen to the body and the organs once death has occurred.

assigned.event: By the grantor in the instrucciones previas document

transitions.event: Fallecimiento; se aplica lo previsto sobre el destino del cuerpo

nameEn.en: Person who decides the disposition of the body

poaDurableByDefault.note: An ordinary mandate ends on death and when representative curatela is established; durability requires an express subsistence clause under art. 256.

springingPoaAllowed.note: Art. 257 allows a power granted only for the future case of needing support, proved as the grantor provided.

organDonationModel.name: Ley 30/1979
organDonationModel.note: Removal is permitted unless the deceased had expressly recorded their opposition.

digitalAssetsFiduciaryStatute.note: No dedicated digital-asset statute in the Civil Code; digital assets follow the estate, since heirs succeed to all rights and obligations by the fact of death.

healthAgentStartsOn.note: Instrucciones previas take effect when the grantor can no longer express their wishes personally.

healthAgentPostDeathAuthority.note: The same document governs the destination of the body and organs after death.
